title: Right to Safety
description: right to be protected from hazardous or unsafe goods and services

conditions: the goods complained against suffer from any of the defects specified in the complaint or that any of the allegations contained in the complaint about the services or any unfair trade practices, or claims for compensation under product liability are proved
